violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN WALK-IN COOLER AND WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED TWO OUT OF THE THREE HANDWASHING SINKS IN BACK KITCHEN MISSING PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ALWAYS PROVIDED AT HANDWASHING SINKS.
